new_articles.title: Kia enters India’s hybrid passenger vehicle market with 3-row SUV Sorento
new_articles.summary: Kia 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Kia enters India’s hybrid passenger vehicle market with 3-row SUV Sorento'이다. Kia India has launched its new Sorento SUV, marking its entry into the hybrid vehicle market. The premium three-row sport-utility vehicle is priced at Rs 28 lakh and offers hybrid and diesel options. Production of the Sorento has commenced in India, with pre-bookings now open for Rs 25,000. This new model will compete with established players like the Toyota Fortuner and Skoda Kodiaq. “For the first time, Kia is stepping into a segment in India we've never played in before-the premium three-way service space-and we have chosen to enter it with a nameplate that, in fact, carries a global legacy: the Kia Sorento ,” Atul Sood- Senior VP- Sales & Marketing at Kia said Kia's decision to introduce a hybrid alongside a conventional diesel powertrain also reflects the varied nature of India's transition towards cleaner mobility With the price announcement, Kia will complete the India-market rollout of the Sorento, giving buyers in the premium SUV segment another option that combines an electrified powertrain with the space and capability of a large SUV MD, CEO Gwang Gu Lee at Kia unveiled that the Sorento has a connectivity technology and hence becomes something more of an intelligent vehicle The new launch introduces an entire new dimension of real-time generative AI capabilities through Kia AI assistance. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

Police have been investigating Bang, the billionaire founder and chairperson of Hybe, over allegations that he misled investors in 2019 by indicating that Hybe had no immediate plans to go public, prompting them to sell their shares to a private equity fund shortly before the company proceeded with an initial public offering Police earlier said that the fund may have paid Bang somewhere around US$147-million in a side deal that promised him 30 per cent of post-IPO stock sale profits By the numbers: How BTS measures up in Canada South Korean media reported that police referred four other people, including Hybe executives and private equity fund officials, to prosecutors on Thursday as well, asking for their indictment Hybe officials have said Bang denies any wrongdoing “We have consistently responded to the allegations with objective evidence and facts,” Bang’s legal team said in a statement Thursday. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
